issues.description: The problem statement and solution refer to a class named 'Meal', but the template repository provides a class named 'Order' with the same structure. This naming mismatch is likely to confuse students (they will look for a Meal class to implement/instantiate) and may cause compilation/test failures if automated tests or instructions expect a Meal type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Either rename the template's Order.java to Meal.java (keeping its implementation), or add a Meal class in the template with the same API as in the solution and update any template references. Ensure the class name used in the problem statement, template, and tests is the same (Meal).
